title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: Between life and death there is a library. When Nora Seed finds herself there, she has a chance to undo her regrets and try out each of her possible lives.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A proven framework for improving every day. James Clear reveals practical strategies that will teach you exactly how to form good habits and break bad ones.

title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
description: A brave and heartbreaking novel that digs into the complexities of love in a way that will forever change you.

title: Fourth Wing
author: Rebecca Yarros
description: Enter the brutal and elite world of a war college for dragon riders in this number one bestselling fantasy romance.

title: Wind and Truth
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: The concluding volume of the first arc of the Stormlight Archive. Dalinar faces the greatest challenge of his life.

title: The God of the Woods
author: Liz Moore
description: A missing girl, a powerful family, and decades of dark secrets collide in this propulsive thriller set in the Adirondack wilderness.

title: James
author: Percival Everett
description: A reimagining of Adventures of Huckleberry Finn told from the perspective of the enslaved Jim, now named James.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: The tale of Kvothe — from his childhood in a troupe of traveling players, to his years spent as a near-feral orphan, to his time at the University.

title: The Wise Man's Fear
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe takes his first steps on the path of the Amyr as he ventures beyond the University, seeking to uncover the truth about the Chandrian.

title: The Slow Regard of Silent Things
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: A brief side story set in the world of the Kingkiller Chronicle, following the strange and wonderful Auri.

title: Intermezzo
author: Sally Rooney
description: Two brothers, each dealing with grief in their own way, find themselves drawn into unexpected relationships after their father's death.

title: All Fours
author: Miranda July
description: A woman sets off on a road trip from LA to New York, but stops after just one mile — and stays for two weeks.
